1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a __gentle, non-destructive medium__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __as the sole solvent__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation, __wherein said cold, heat and agitation are done in a controlled manner__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated at least once.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __applying controlled heat to__ the shed cellular material and agitation.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated at least once.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from the group consisting of: plant cell wall degrading enzymes, phosphatases, and proteases__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@ or a __complementary enzymatic composition__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __using a protocol for DNA extraction__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material to facilitate __separation of the DNA from cellular debris__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a __quiescent state__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __using techniques selected from PCR, sequencing, or microarray analysis__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __for agronomic traits__. 

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification __is included to enhance the quantity of DNA available for analysis__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __developed from molecular analysis results__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using programmable systems for data processing and embryo handling__.
